findings.evidence: Lines 68–72 prove the required generic equality privately, while lines 95–98 and 118–122 expose only equality to `hopfSpec.map`; both closed-immersion proofs immediately need the private underlying-map lemma at lines 104–105 and 129–130.
findings.fix: Add public, preferably `[simp]`, lemmas identifying each `.hom.hom.left` with the corresponding `Spec.map` for `mkQuotient` and `quotientMapOfLe`; then make the implementation restatements private or remove them if unnecessary.
findings.issue: `quotientSpecι_def` and `quotientSpecMapOfLe_def` (line 118) only restate the `hopfSpec` implementation; the useful underlying-map characterization is kept private in `hopfSpec_map_left`, forcing downstream users to unfold Mathlib internals.

summary: The scheme morphism wrappers expose their construction but lack the public characteristic lemmas needed to use their underlying scheme maps without unfolding `hopfSpec`.
